# The visual components, canvas and wrappers get their overview

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

> **Amended on 16 Nov 2026.** Three things changed after this leaf was written, none of them a contributor's doing. A record without a cover renders no card (#21119). The examples are sorted into 22 groups in place of the Components family (#21141, PR #21162). Which examples stay, are renewed or retire is decided per entry on #21142. **This leaf delivers the records and their captions.** A maintainer applies the group ids and the record schema of today's `dev` when the pull request is integrated. Covers are not part of it and are no contributor's task.

The 13.5 gate asks that a stranger finds each component family's examples as an overview in which every example names what it proves (`ROADMAP.md`). `/examples/grid` is the pattern: 21 captioned Grid and Table demonstrations (#20500). The steward's map on #20498 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6757406109)) lists the families. This leaf covers the components a visitor looks at.

## The Problem

`examples/` holds 30 demonstrations of visual components, canvas, charts and wrappers around third-party libraries. Four have a catalog record (`helix`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery`, `gallery`), and 26 can be reached only by typing their URL. Two external records (`offscreen-canvas`, `liquid-glass`) belong here too. Those six records get their captions through PR #21162, which gives every record a home group; the 26 are this leaf's.

## The Architectural Reality

- One record per example in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`; the record's shape is documented on `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`. The records of the Grid and Table group are the reference for the length and tone of a caption.
- A unit spec fails on a record that publishes a card without `feature` or `lookFor`. A record whose `image` is `null` renders no card, so a record can merge before its cover exists and appears when the cover lands.
- Inventory at `62f75736ba`, each path under `examples/` with its own `neo-config.json`: under `component/`: `canvas`, `carousel`, `chip`, `circle`, `clock`, `coronaGallery` (record `covid-gallery`), `coronaHelix` (record `covid-helix`), `gallery` (record `gallery`), `graphScene`, `helix` (record `helix`), `magicmovetext`, `markdown`, `mwc/button`, `mwc/buttons`, `mwc/textField`, `mwc/textFields`, `process`, `process/realWorldExample`, `progress`, `splitter`, `statusbadge`, `timer`, `toast`, `video`, `wrapper/cesiumJS`, `wrapper/googleMaps`, `wrapper/monacoEditor`, `wrapper/openStreetMaps` · `charts` · `videoMove`.
- **The home group of each path**, from the table on #21141: `component/gallery`, `component/coronaGallery`, `component/helix`, `component/coronaHelix`, `component/carousel` → `lists` · `charts`, `component/canvas`, `component/graphScene`, `component/wrapper/cesiumJS`, `…/googleMaps`, `…/openStreetMaps` → `charts` · `component/toast` → `dialogs` · `videoMove` → `platform` · every other `component/*` (`mwc/*` and `wrapper/monacoEditor` among them) → `components`. The external records: `offscreen-canvas` → `platform`, `liquid-glass` → `components`.
- The four `wrapper/` demos and `charts` load a third-party library; some need a key or a network service. The record's `scope` field exists for that.
- `videoMove` moves a video component between two containers of one window without destroying it (`examples/videoMove/MainContainer.mjs:64-66`); whether the playback survives the move is for the caption's author to observe.
- neomjs.com answers by user agent: a request without a browser user agent gets 404 on a dist example path that a browser opens.
- Design authority: n/a — adds catalog records, calls no existing behavior wrong.

## The Fix

For every demonstration of the inventory: run it (`npm run server-start`, then its `index.html`), read its view and controller, and decide. It gets a record when one sentence can say what it proves; otherwise it stays out and the pull request says why. A record carries a stable string `id`, `name`, its group, `component`, `feature` (what it proves), `lookFor` (one action and what to observe), `scope` where it needs a key, a network service or has a limit, its URLs and source, and `image: null`. The new records stand as one block directly after the record `gallery`, so that parallel pull requests touch different lines.

**The six records that exist keep their position, their cover and the captions they have on `dev`.** They were read against the running examples beside the pairs of the open pull request ([the read on PR #21162](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21162#issuecomment-6926342053)): where the two differ, a caption names a control or a gesture the example does not have (`helix`: no drag, the control is `Item Angle`; `gallery` and `covid-gallery`: no spacing or perspective control; `liquid-glass`: the panel moves by itself, no pointer listener), a limit this configuration does not have (`covid-helix`: the example pins its snapshot), or leaves out the proof (`offscreen-canvas`: the main thread stopped while the points move).

**For the open pull request #21105:** its new records and their captions are the contribution, and they stay the author's. A maintainer brings the branch onto today's `dev`: the group ids of the list above, the URL fields as `dev` has them now, the six existing records as `dev` has them, and the spec's counts. The author is asked for nothing further unless a caption turns out wrong in the running example.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every path of the inventory is a record with its home group, or is named in the pull request with its reason for staying out.
- [ ] Each `feature` and `lookFor` was checked in the running example; the pull request names the build and the browser. A demonstration that needs a key or a service says so in `scope`, or stays out when a visitor would see an error.
- [ ] A caption states no number the example does not show, names no control the example does not have, and names no commercial feature.
- [ ] Every URL of a record opens that example's own document in a browser on neomjs.com, in each of the four builds it names, or the build is omitted on the record.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples` passes with the new record counts. The count of visible cards does not change, since no new record has a cover.

## Out of Scope

- **Covers and their capture recipes.** They are #21120's, shot with the producer of #20679 once #21142 has ruled on the entry.
- The captions of the six existing records: PR #21162.
- The verdict on an example (keep, renew, retire): #21142. A record for an example that later retires is removed there.
- The group definitions: #21141.
- Buttons, containers, lists, menus, tabs, toolbars and trees (#20694); new examples; an engine fix for an example that turns out broken: file it and leave the example out.

## Avoided Traps

- A caption taken from a directory name: the grid map on #20498 checked configured views, controllers and stores, and several names promised more than the example shows.
- A wrapper published while it shows a missing-key error on the public site.
- Moving the existing records: the showcase order is delivered intent (#19640).
- **Asking a first-time contributor to follow a brief that moved under them.** The records were written to the brief of 10 Nov; what changed since is integrated by a maintainer.
- **A URL check without a browser user agent.** curl's default gets 404 where a browser gets the page; a status code alone also passes a redirect to the Portal's home page. Check the document's title.
